name: Discovery stacks from casting Artificer's Wand or Wand of Time (#537)
contract: Discovery 500116 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) twice, on Discovery 704197 and 806201, but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the ranged class damage of Wand of Time or Artificer's Wand (100% chance), a single Artificer's Wand hit should apply the Discovery stack (704197) to the caster.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Discovery stack before any cast
Artificer's Wand hit applies a Discovery stack
